source: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/ — Jira Cloud platform REST API v3. Atlassian operates Cloud as a continuously-updated service and publishes no per-version end-of-support date; API-version deprecations are announced separately on the changelog. Confirmed 2026-07-25.

https://confluence.atlassian.com/support/atlassian-support-end-of-life-policy-201851003.html — Jira Software 10.3, Long-Term Support release, end of support 5 December 2026. Atlassian supports releases for two years after the initial feature or LTS release. Confirmed 2026-07-25.
https://confluence.atlassian.com/support/atlassian-support-end-of-life-policy-201851003.html — Jira Software 11.3, Long-Term Support release, end of support 3 December 2027. Confirmed 2026-07-25.
https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/ — Grafana Cloud is a continuously-updated hosted service; Grafana Labs publishes no per-version end-of-support date for it. Confirmed 2026-07-25.

https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/upgrade-guide/when-to-upgrade/ — 12.4.x (last minor of 12), released 24 February 2026, support end date 24 May 2027, support level 'Patch Support'. Confirmed 2026-07-25.
https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/upgrade-guide/when-to-upgrade/ — 13.1.x, released 22 June 2026, support end date 20 March 2027, support level 'Patch Support'. Confirmed 2026-07-25.
